agent.type: plain-Python ReAct loop (no LangGraph in the measured path)
agent.decision_source: scripted TaskSpec turn sequence, deterministic per (task, seed)
agent.llm: in-process mock: asyncio.sleep drawn from seeded lognormal (zero thread CPU, models remote inference wait), synthetic response of profile-drawn size
agent.orchestration: OrchEngine: task-graph build (ORCH_SETUP), readiness scan + scatter-on-completion dispatch (ORCH_DISPATCH), mirroring orchestration_engine/software/engine_sim.cpp semantics

tools.search: regex scan (phrase then word-alternation) over 50 MB corpus, top-5 snippets
tools.code_exec: exec of the task-supplied Python snippet, bounded builtins
tools.retrieve: full cosine top-5 over 100k x 384 float32 matrix, query embedded deterministically from query text hash
tools.calculator: sympy (or plain eval fallback) on the task-supplied expression
tools.api: mock remote API: HTTP_CLIENT-timed request build and response envelope parse around a seeded lognormal asyncio sleep (pure I/O wait)

agent.turn_mechanics: single call, fan-out burst (several calls per turn, completions land back-to-back on an ALL_OF join), chained handoff (pipe_result: parse previous result, rebuild next args), sub-agent spawning (child sessions with their own task graphs), structured emission (re-emit and validate the full accumulated JSON per turn)
agent.execution_model: asyncio, all sessions share one event-loop thread; optional --threads mode for the comparison point
agent.clocks: wall = perf_counter_ns; CPU = thread_time_ns per region; process user/system = os.times or psutil at run start/end
agent.nesting_rule: exclusive self-time: inner region pauses its parent
